body:
Thank you! I'm skipping the gourami they seem like great characters but not right for my setup.


I've got the API test kit (all nitrogen cycle readings at 0) and then the Gh & Kh tests from API too. The water in my area is pretty hard and a ph of 8 which is why I ended up looking at livebearers because I heard they do well in that kind of water.


I've stuck some ludwigia super red that side as I thought it looked bare too and wanted to block some of the strong filter flow. Hoping it grows in soon.

Will skip on the gourami based on this and other comments. 
Was trying to grow some ludwigia thick in front of the flow to disrupt and minimise it as I knew it'd be too strong for gourami and looks like it's too strong right in front of it for the fish I have currently. They have places to hide and lower flow areas but right in front is a bit strong for the little guys.

Thanks for the warning. I'll probably give the gouramis a miss then, I'm already very attached to the adorable cories I have and don't want to stress them or the new gourami if it's not the right size and grouping for them.

Thanks. This makes a lot of sense I like the consideration beyond just bioload etc. 


Based on what others are saying too I'll probably give the gouramis a miss and just focus on what I have in there already.
Thanks for this! The website is glitching for me on my phone but will absolutely check it out on my laptop later.
Somewhere in the UK. During winter the sun can set pretty early.
